subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently overwriting [AI-assisted]model-selection: warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently …

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve shipped last-match selection while warning, or may this PR intentionally switch existing duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is a narrow bug fix, but changing the selected provider/model for existing config is a compatibility and auth-provider routing decision that should not be inferred from this external PR.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
options.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model, emit duplicate-alias warnings, and add matching alias-index coverage.

options.title: Approve First-Match Precedence
options.body: Accept the provider/model reroute only with explicit upgrade proof, tests, and release-note context for affected duplicate configs.

options.title: Use One Unified Replacement
options.body: Pause this branch and land a single duplicate-alias fix that covers both helper and alias-index paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
recommendation.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model, emit duplicate-alias warnings, and add matching alias-index coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the shared model-selection helper and the provider-qualified alias behavior that now documents last-wins compatibility.
